text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you wanna go observe thelights that which pain the—wait, no,paint, sorry. The lights that whichpaint the joyous, uh, nativuhty? Onthis silent night!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Uhhh... Well. Clearly she has no ideawhat she's saying either, but if I hadto guess... I think I'm being invited outto look at the holiday lights around town.
choice_data_list: You mean the holiday light displays? I'm in!
You mean the holiday light displays? I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I'm glad you could decipher<n>that. The lights
feel even more special<n>when you spice 'em up
with badass<n>lingo, y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, it's gonna be a<n>pros...digious? Prodis...
Uh... It's<n>gonna be COOL! So see ya tonight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That evening, I meet Vodka as<n>promised, and we hit
the town.<n>There's just one slight problem...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Behold—the holy night be...queaths?<n>Its liminous
gifts. Or was it luminious?<n>Either way, a
ron-dee-voo with<n>destiny awaits!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Which is my cue to, uh... Ahem!<n>Trainer! "Let the
lights engulf you!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With an awkwardly dramatic flair to<n>her declaration,
she runs towards the<n>display.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How's it look?! I bet you're<n>drowning in the sea of
lights now,<n>huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why isn't it working? Just... hang on<n>a minute! I'll
be right back, so stay<n>there!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What do I do?! I drowned everyone in<n>the backlight,
but Trainer and the<n>crowd just looked at me funny...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You need not worry... for Chaos will<n>be upon you
soon.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You have already prised open<n>Pandemonium. Give
in to the<n>urges—burn through the inhibitions of<n>your
psyche. And then... run wild,<n>Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Run wild... Got it! Thanks again, Big G!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thanks for waitin'! Now that<n>the light's
engulfed you, you've gotta<n>burn up your psyche
runnin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: C'mon, get those feet movin'! We'rerunning wild tonight!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Not bad! Be careful not to run anyone<n>over, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, I know you can go faster<n>than that! I'm
practically havin' to<n>walk to keep your pace. Let's
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whew, that's a full lap of the lights!<n>And now...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uh, what should we do next?
choice_data_list:
If you tell me what Gimlet said, maybe I can figure it
out.

If you tell me what Gimlet said, maybe I can figure it
out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait... how'd you know about her?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Did I let somethin' slip? Aaaagh, I<n>was tryin' to
keep it on the down low,<n>y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to reassure Vodka that<n>there's nothing
"uncool" about<n>seeking advice, and she eventually
starts explaining the situation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, everyone's gettin' so hyped<n>over some
dumb old string lights.<n>What are they, toddlers?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm more mature than that, though.I'm gonna do somethin' cool. Heh.

The night alone bears no form. The<n>tethered chains
of stars give the void<n>shape; the joyous cries of
mortal<n>observers lend it purpose.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Big G?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The dawn of Eve is nigh! One cannot<n>neglect this
purest of nights... for this<n>sacred Eve has long been
used in<n>mortal rituals to appreciate the miracle<n>of life.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If you would give freely your<n>gratitude, then revel in
the lights and<n>music... and let your virtuous deeds
shine forth.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Give freely... and shine forth... That<n>sounds so... so
COOL!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Curious now, are you? Go out<n>and experience
the time-old rites.<n>Perhaps they will give you the
perspective mere words cannot.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Yeah! I'll enjoy the holidays to<n>the max!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You'd also do well to invite company.<n>The
synchronization of your souls will<n>amplify the
Eve's joyous effects<n>upon you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I've just gotta bring someone<n>with me to go
see the holiday lights,<n>right? Consider it done!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Aaand that's why we're here! Man,<n>Big G always
has the coolest ideas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm seeing Gimlet's angle<n>here. She's
just encouraging Vodka<n>to enjoy the festivities. In
that case...
choice_data_list:
True, but I think it'd be even cooler to enjoy the
festivities your own way!

True, but I think it'd be even cooler to enjoy the
festivities your own way!

Why don't you ask her to join us, then? The more,
the merrier, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm seeing Gimlet's angle<n>here. She's
just encouraging Vodka<n>to enjoy the festivities. In
that case...
choice_data_list:
True, but I think it'd be even cooler to enjoy the
festivities your own way!

True, but I think it'd be even cooler to enjoy the
festivities your own way!

Why don't you ask her to join us, then? The more,
the merrier, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My own way, huh? Yeah... It'd bepretty lame of me to steal her style.I've gotta stick to my guns.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And uh... there's actually something I<n>kinda wanted
to do!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Panting... Whew... I just had to seethe view from the peak.
choice_data_list: Wheeze... S-sure... but did we really have to take the stairs?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's like climbin' a mountain!<n>Sometimes, you just
gotta do it<n>yourself, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. So you've found your path.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ask... her... ...That's genius!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, we were thinkin' it'd be<n>extra fun if you
looked at all the lights<n>with us!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe... What a proposition.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I did not foresee this, but it is these<n>very twists of
fate that race the heart<n>and spur the soul.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I accept. Let us rejoice in the<n>heavens' light as
one.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, I was just thinkin' it'd be cool to<n>come up here!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Shhh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
We stand amidst the stars, high<n>above the mortal
sphere. Hush now,<n>Vodka, and drink in this sacred,
silent<n>night.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That... That sounds so cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so... Vodka's admiration for<n>Tanino Gimlet
grew three sizes that<n>day.
